summary: Frontend-only verification of Dashboard infinite refetch-loop fix in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx. Playwright run on mobile viewport (390x844) against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL: logged in with admin/admin123, dashboard mounted. Instrumented a page.on('request') counter to detect any ongoing refetch activity. Result: 0 network requests in the 8s idle window after initial dashboard mount, and 0 requests in the 8s idle window after navigating Penjualan -> Produk -> back to Dashboard (returning triggers a one-shot invalidateQueries burst of ~6 requests which settles immediately - exactly the intended behavior). No 'Maximum update depth' / 'Too many re-renders' console errors. Dashboard renders all expected sections: Halo/Toko header, Penjualan Hari Ini (Rp0), Transaksi, Item Terjual, Total Produk, Stok Rendah, Ringkasan Penjualan (Minggu/Bulan/Tahun Ini), Penjualan 7 Hari Terakhir bar chart, Aksi Cepat, bottom tabs (Dashboard/Penjualan/Produk/Lainnya). RefreshControl spinner is bound to local 'refreshing' state (default false) and does not spin on load. Fix VERIFIED.
critical_code_review_comments: useFocusEffect correctly uses stable deps [queryClient, isAdmin] and calls queryClient.invalidateQueries - no dependency on React Query result objects, so no re-trigger loop.
RefreshControl.refreshing is bound to a local useState 'refreshing' (default false) rather than stats.isFetching, so the pull-to-refresh spinner cannot spin forever on background refetches.
onRefresh correctly toggles refreshing true/false around Promise.all([stats.refetch(), low.refetch()]).

Non-blocking: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' warnings observed from RN Web internals - not caused by this fix, cosmetic only.
seed_data_creation: None. Web preview uses in-memory sql.js which starts empty - expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard refetch-loop is fixed. If regressions occur, re-run the same approach: attach page.on('request') counter after reaching dashboard, wait 2s, snapshot count, wait 8s, delta should be ~0. Also check for 'Maximum update depth exceeded' in console.
rca_of_issue: Original loop: useFocusEffect's useCallback listed the React Query result objects (stats, low, etc.) in its deps. On every refetch those objects were re-created, which re-fired the callback, which refetched again -> infinite loop. The spinner stayed on because RefreshControl.refreshing was bound to stats.isFetching, which was perpetually true. Fix: deps reduced to [queryClient, isAdmin] (both stable) and invalidateQueries is called instead of refetch(); RefreshControl.refreshing is now bound to a dedicated manual 'refreshing' state controlled only by onRefresh. Verified end-to-end via Playwright.
